description: Scrape Vinted (second-hand fashion marketplace) items, sellers, brands, and feedbacks across 19 country domains.

autoEscalateOnBlock.description: If a 403/Cloudflare challenge appears on a direct request, automatically retry through Apify proxy (datacenter then residential).
autoEscalateOnBlock.title: Auto-escalate to proxy on block

brandId.description: Vinted numeric brand_id. Use "Search brand registry" mode to discover IDs (e.g. Nike=53, adidas=14).
brandId.title: Brand ID (mode=byBrand)

brandIds.description: Constrain item search to one or more brand IDs (e.g. [53] for Nike).
brandIds.title: Brand IDs filter (mode=search)

brandKeyword.description: Keyword to search the Vinted brand registry.
brandKeyword.title: Brand keyword (mode=byBrandSearch)

catalogId.description: Vinted catalog (category) ID. Common: 1904 (Women clothes), 5 (Men clothes), 1193 (Kids), 1242 (Bags), 1231 (Beauty).
catalogId.title: Catalog / category ID (mode=byCatalog)

catalogIds.description: Constrain item search to one or more catalog IDs.
catalogIds.title: Catalog IDs filter (mode=search)

colorIds.description: Constrain item search to one or more color IDs (1=Black, 3=Grey, 5=White, 7=Beige, 9=Pink, 11=Purple, 12=Red, 13=Yellow, 14=Blue, 16=Green, 17=Orange, 19=Brown, 30=Multicolour).
colorIds.title: Color IDs filter (mode=search)

containsKeyword.description: Drop items whose title or description does not contain this keyword (case-insensitive substring).
containsKeyword.title: Title / description contains keyword (filter)

cookieHeader.description: Optional logged-in cookie header (e.g. _vinted_xx_session=...; access_token_web=...). Not required for public endpoints; pass only if you see persistent 401/403.
cookieHeader.title: Cookie header (optional)

materialIds.description: Constrain item search to one or more material IDs.
materialIds.title: Material IDs filter (mode=search)

minRating.description: Drop items whose seller's feedback rating is below this value (scale 1.0-5.0). Applied client-side after fetch; items with no rating attached pass through unchanged.
minRating.title: Min seller feedback rating (filter)

mode.description: search: keyword/filters → items. byUrl: explicit Vinted URLs (item, member, brand, catalog). byUser: user closet by user_id. byBrand: brand catalog by brand id or slug. byCatalog: items in a Vinted catalog (category) id. byBrandSearch: search the brand registry. byUserFeedbacks: seller reviews/feedbacks.
mode.title: Scrape mode

priceFrom.description: Minimum price (in the country's local currency).
priceFrom.title: Min price (mode=search)

priceTo.description: Maximum price (in the country's local currency).
priceTo.title: Max price (mode=search)

proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy configuration. Used only when useProxy is enabled.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

sizeIds.description: Constrain item search to one or more size IDs.
sizeIds.title: Size IDs filter (mode=search)

statusIds.description: Filter by condition: 6=New with tags, 1=New without tags, 2=Very good, 3=Good, 4=Satisfactory.
statusIds.title: Condition / status IDs filter (mode=search)

urls.description: Direct Vinted URLs (item, member/user, brand, catalog).
urls.title: URLs (mode=byUrl)

useProxy.description: Route HTTP requests through Apify proxy. Vinted is generally accessible without proxy from datacenter IPs; enable if 403/Cloudflare challenges appear.
useProxy.title: Use Apify proxy

title: Vinted Scraper Input
